    Proper residue categories are representation-finite #

    Let A be minimal representation-infinite with a twisted multiplicative basis over a ray category P with cancellation. For a nonzero non-invertible τ, A/⟨τ⟩ is representation-finite, so P/τ has bounded chains; by Roiter's theorem the twist of the quotient basis is exact, hence A/⟨τ⟩ ≅ k(P/τ), and the linearization k(P/τ) is representation-finite (RayQuiver.MulBasis.isRepresentationFinite_res). In the language of BO13a, P is a minimal representation-infinite ray category; cleaving functors into P/τ can be used with the untwisted basis of k(P/τ).
